description: Turn messy text or a web page into clean JSON: name the fields you want ("company", "price: in USD", "emails") and get them back as a JSON object, with null for anything not found. Great for scraping, lead capture, invoices, job posts and forms. Pay per call; ask the pricing tool for a quote.

fields.description: Fields to extract, optionally with a hint after a colon: ["company", "price: monthly price in USD", "emails: all email addresses"].

text.description: Text to process (first 12,000 characters are used). Use this or url.

url.description: A public web page to read instead of text, e.g. a news article or blog post.

name: extract_data
title: Extract structured data
